speaker: Doctor
text: I'm Dr. Agent. To understand your symptoms of fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes, can you tell me your age and gender? Have you noticed any other specific symptoms like fever, cough, or changes in your bowel habits?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is significant weight loss combined with your "B symptoms" (fever, night sweats). Can you tell me if you have noticed any skin changes, bruising, or if the lymph nodes are painful when touched? Also, do you have a history of smoking or alcohol use?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hodgkin Lymphoma. The combination of supraclavicular lymphadenopathy, B symptoms (fever, night sweats, weight loss), and a fixed, non-tender lymph node is highly suggestive of this malignancy. I am requesting an LDH level and a CT scan of the chest, abdomen, and pelvis to stage the disease. REQUEST TEST: LDH. REQUEST IMAGES: CT Chest_Abdomen_Pelvis.
